_doc: The C# engine's feature catalogue: the ONE source both sides read. Python (osmose/engine_cs/capabilities.py) detects which features a config needs; the C# engine embeds this file and refuses a bundle that needs a feature not marked implemented. Ids are stable: never renumber, only append. status: planned (phase 1-4), refused (spec Q4: Python parses but ignores; the C# engine refuses), not_planned (stays on the Python engine). Flip 'implemented' only in the PR that makes the feature run end to end.

features.name: core
features.description: the Phase 1 engine: step loop, VB growth, interleaved mortality (type I), stage accessibility, size-based feeding stages, LTL forcing, constant larva mortality, lagged starvation, fishing by rate (age knife-edge or no selectivity, seasonality, maps, discards), reproduction, map and random movement including out-of-domain schools (null maps, uncovered ages or steps, failed placement) and mortality.out.rate, cutoff age, minimal outputs

features.name: full_outputs
features.description: any output beyond output.minimal.enabled = true (life-stage, by-age and by-size, SSB, mean TL and size, yield in numbers, diet)

features.name: stock_recruitment
features.description: a stock-recruitment relationship (stock.recruitment.type other than none)

features.name: oxygen_benthos
features.description: bottom oxygen scaling the benthos carrying capacity

features.name: depletable_ltl
features.description: depletable LTL resources with logistic regrowth

features.name: additional_rate_by_step
features.description: additional mortality rate by time step (file)

features.name: larva_rate_by_step
features.description: larva mortality rate by time step (file)

features.name: functional_response_2_3
features.description: Holling type II or III functional response

features.name: species_accessibility
features.description: species-level accessibility matrix with no stage matrix

features.name: feeding_stage_metric
features.description: feeding stages by age, weight or trophic level

features.name: genetics
features.description: genetics (Ev-OSMOSE); runs on the Python engine

features.name: economics
features.description: fleet economics; runs on the Python engine

features.name: java_compat_rng
features.description: engine.rng.java_compat: the Python engine's Java-compatible RNG mode

features.name: rate_by_class
features.description: fishing or additional rates by age or size class (spec Q4: refused)

features.name: selectivity_type_2_3
features.description: fishing selectivity types other than -1, 0 and 1 (spec Q4: refused)

features.name: kill_if_no_school
features.description: simulation.kill.if.no.school.enabled (stop the run when a species has no fish left); runs on the Python engine

features.name: resource_percent_log
features.description: simulation.resources.computePercent.legacy = false (OSMOSE 4.4.0): a predator's share of a resource taken in log size

features.name: maturity_stochastic
features.description: species.maturity.mode = stochastic (OSMOSE 4.4.0): maturity drawn from a normal ogive (l50, l75)

features.name: larva_density_dependence
features.description: mortality.additional.larva.referencedensity (OSMOSE 4.4.x): the larval rate scaled by the spawning stock

features.name: mortality_rate_factor
features.description: multiplier and seasonality of the constant additional and larval mortality rates (OSMOSE 4.4.x)

features.name: movement_gradient
features.description: movement.distribution.method = gradient (OSMOSE 4.4.x): moves drawn from a probability map near the school

features.name: output_regions
features.description: output.regions (OSMOSE 4.4.x): every output also written over the schools of each region
